description: This Java abstract class defines a base exception with internationalization support, allowing subclasses to represent specific platform exceptions with translatable messages.

classes.name: AbstractPlatformException
classes.description: An abstract base class for platform-specific exceptions, supporting internationalization and optional chaining of causes.
